# GitHub Copilot project instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), the [assessment-only checklist](../docs/specifications/assessment-scope.md), and the [source-backed specification register](../docs/specifications/README.md) before suggesting MPEG frame/parser or HTTP changes. The linked topic documents define MPEG-1 Layer III bitfields/free-format, ID3 and encoder metadata, MIME/upload semantics, and supported/out-of-scope cases.

Do not assume all `.mp3` files are one bitrate/index; **free-format index 0 is supported** with bounded inference, MPEG-2/2.5 and other Layers are out of scope. Do not use an NPM MP3 frame parser or decoder for the implementation. The owner-selected HTTP default and explicit `includeVbrHeaderFrame=false` exclude one recognized initial Xing/Info/VBRI metadata frame; `true` counts all physical MPEG frames. Direct `countMp3Frames()` calls retain their physical default; ID3 records are never MPEG frames. The sample returns 6089 by HTTP default and 6090 with `true`; evaluator intent remains unconfirmed. See [`frame-count-contract.md`](../docs/frame-count-contract.md). Preserve streaming, limits and deterministic errors.
